title: Immunofluorescent Staining of Mouse Pancreas for Islet Cell Mass Analysis
author: Islet and Pancreas Analysis Core
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzvwp67e
materials: Gather reagents for immunostaining, noting that steps 9-11, 15, and 17-18 can be performed in Kartell staining chambers (each holds ~50 mL). Always use freshly-made antibody and wash buffers (steps 4, 6); other reagents can be prepared ahead of time and stored at 4 °C .

Aspirate the blocking buffer, add primary antibodies diluted in antibody buffer (see Table 1 ), and incubate in a humidified chamber Overnight at 4 °C . Use a sufficient volume (approximately 200-300 µl) to ensure each section is entirely covered with antibody solution. Table 1: Detailed information for primary and secondary antibodies.

Add secondary antibodies diluted in antibody buffer (see Table 1 ) and incubate for 01:30:00 at room temperature in a humidified chamber. Use a sufficient volume (approximately 200-300 µl) to ensure each section is entirely covered with antibody solution.

steps.title: Prepare 10% Triton X-100 stock
steps.instruction: Combine 3 mL Triton‑X‑100 with 27 mL 1X PBS to make 30 mL of 10 % Triton X‑100 stock; mix on a shaker for 30 min or until fully dissolved; store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL Triton‑X‑100 to a container.

steps.title: Prepare permeabilization solution
steps.instruction: Mix 1 mL 10 % Triton stock with 49 mL 1X PBS to obtain 50 mL of 0.2 % Triton permeabilization solution.

steps.title: Prepare blocking buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 0.2 mL Normal Donkey Serum (NDS) with 3.8 mL 1X PBS to make 4 mL of 5 % NDS blocking buffer.

steps.title: Prepare antibody buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.1 g BSA in 9.8 mL 1X PBS, add 0.1 mL 10 % Triton stock, filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter, and store at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 0.1 g BSA and add to 9.8 mL 1X PBS.

steps.title: Prepare DAPI staining solution
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL DAPI stock (5 mg/mL) to 50 mL 1X PBS to obtain a 1:25,000 DAPI solution; keep protected from light or prepare immediately before use.

substeps.instruction: Mix gently and protect from light.

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 148.5 mL 1X PBS with 1.5 mL 10 % Triton X‑100 stock to make 150 mL wash buffer.

steps.title: Thaw sections and air‑dry
steps.instruction: Allow frozen cryosections to thaw at room temperature and air‑dry for approximately 30 minutes.

steps.title: Remove OCT with PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash slides three times in 1X PBS, each wash lasting 5 minutes; decant or transfer to a fresh chamber after each wash.

substeps.instruction: Add 1X PBS to slide, incubate 5 min.

steps.title: Permeabilize tissue sections
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in permeabilization solution for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after permeabilization
steps.instruction: Wash sections three times in 1X PBS, each wash 5 minutes; decant or change chamber after each wash.

steps.title: Outline sections with PAP pen
steps.instruction: Draw rectangles around each tissue section using a PAP pen and let the ink dry for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Block sections with blocking buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200–300 µL blocking buffer to fully cover each section; incubate at room temperature for 1 hour 30 minutes in a humidified chamber.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 200–300 µL blocking buffer onto each section.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Aspirate the primary antibody solution and wash the sections three times in wash buffer, each wash 10 minutes; decant or change chamber after each wash.

steps.title: DAPI counterstain incubation
steps.instruction: Aspirate the secondary antibody solution and incubate slides in DAPI staining solution for 10 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add DAPI solution, incubate 10 min at RT.

steps.title: Final PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash slides three times in 1X PBS, each wash 15 minutes; decant or switch chamber after each wash.

steps.title: Mount with SlowFade Gold
steps.instruction: Apply 5–10 µL SlowFade Gold mounting medium to each tissue section, ensure complete coverage, then carefully place a coverslip avoiding air bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 5–10 µL mounting medium onto section.

steps.title: Seal slides and dry
steps.instruction: Blot away excess mounting medium from slide edges, seal coverslip edges with nail polish, and allow slides to dry completely before imaging.

substeps.instruction: Apply nail polish around all edges of coverslip.

steps.title: Acquire whole‑slide images
steps.instruction: Scan the stained pancreas sections using a high‑resolution whole‑slide scanner (Aperio ScanScope FL, Leica Biosystems).

steps.title: Analyze images with HALO®
steps.instruction: Use the HALO® image analysis platform to quantify the cross‑sectional area of glucagon‑positive (alpha), insulin‑positive (beta), and somatostatin‑positive (delta) cells; analyze at least five cryosections spaced ~200 µm apart; report each cell type as a percentage of total islet area and calculate cell mass by multiplying area by pancreas weight.
